context_varying_parameters.name: female_probability
context_varying_parameters.reason: Different recruitment composition is represented by source sample count fractions; target female composition is an explicit unsupported scenario. No source proportion is claimed nationally representative.

context_varying_parameters.name: age_distribution
context_varying_parameters.reason: Age eligibility and source age summaries differ. MIND has a bounded beta law, Ayele a source-bin mixture with finite moment equations, and the target a shifted gamma with no upper cutoff. Temporal definitions and the Ayele caption discrepancy remain explicit.

context_varying_parameters.name: bmi_distribution
context_varying_parameters.reason: The evidence gives MIND moments and Ayele category counts, requiring different source marginal families. Target BMI location and spread are unknown; a separate broader lognormal scenario is declared. Within-category and tail shapes remain assumptions.

context_varying_parameters.name: glucose_reference_moments
context_varying_parameters.reason: MIND alone supplies continuous recorded glucose moments. Ayele and target reference moments are explicitly assumed population/selection scenarios, not values converted from binary diabetes odds ratios or target information.

context_varying_parameters.name: measurement_process
context_varying_parameters.reason: Recorded fasting serum, repeated capillary measurements and pooled cleaned target POC are different observation processes. Protocol descriptions motivate distinct structures; unknown feeding, calibration and extra-error quantities are assumptions. Shared mmol/L does not establish measurement equivalence.
